skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Creates concise internal communications using dedicated guidance for 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.
skill.summary: Draft structured internal updates for teams, leaders, and company-wide audiences.
skill.author: ArtemisAI

security_audit.summary: All six static findings are false positives because the flagged text is prose or Markdown file paths, not reconnaissance or command execution. The newsletter guidance creates a disclosure risk because it recommends broad internal sources without requiring confidentiality or audience checks.

remediation.issue: Newsletter guidance may expose sensitive internal information.
remediation.suggestion: Require source authorization, confidentiality checks, audience review, and approval before including Slack, email, calendar, document, or press material.

content.value_statement: Internal updates often become inconsistent, lengthy, or unclear. This skill turns source material into concise 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, and other company messages.
actual_capabilities: Selects guidance based on the requested communication type.
Drafts concise Progress, Plans, and Problems updates for a named team and period.
Organizes company newsletters into scannable sections with prioritized, company-wide updates.
Creates employee FAQ responses with concise answers, uncertainty labels, and authoritative references.
Clarifies audience, purpose, tone, and format for general internal messages.
limitations: Requires users or connected tools to provide current company information.
Cannot verify source accuracy, confidentiality, or authorization without explicit context.
Does not send messages, change source systems, or approve communications.
Provides detailed templates only for 3P updates, newsletters, FAQs, and general messages.

use_cases.title: Prepare Weekly Team Updates
use_cases.description: Turn team notes into a short 3P update with progress, next steps, and blockers.

use_cases.title: Publish Company Newsletters
use_cases.description: Organize approved company events, milestones, and leadership announcements into a scannable newsletter.

use_cases.title: Answer Employee Questions
use_cases.description: Summarize recurring employee questions and draft concise answers grounded in authoritative sources.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for [team] covering [dates]. Use these notes: [notes]. Keep each section to three sentences or fewer.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a basic weekly team update from supplied notes.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter from these approved updates: [updates]. Group related items, prioritize company-wide impact, and keep each bullet concise.
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert approved announcements into a structured company newsletter.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an Employee FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these employee questions and approved sources into an FAQ: [questions and sources]. Mark uncertainty and identify answers requiring executive confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Resolve common questions while preserving uncertainty and source authority.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize a Leadership Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Synthesize [approved sources] into a leadership update for [audience]. Reconcile conflicting facts, surface blockers, cite sources, and separate confirmed information from assumptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Create an advanced update from several reviewed sources.

output_examples.input: Team: Payments. Period: July 13-19. Shipped retry monitoring. Next: launch dashboard. Problem: vendor test data is delayed.
output_examples.output:
Payments (July 13-19)
Progress: We shipped retry monitoring and improved visibility into failed transactions.
Plans: We will launch the operations dashboard next week.
Problems: Vendor test data remains delayed and may affect validation.

output_examples.input: Question: When does enrollment open? Approved answer: August 4. Source: Benefits announcement.
output_examples.output:
Question: When does benefits enrollment open?
Answer: Benefits enrollment opens on August 4. See the Benefits announcement for plan details and deadlines.

best_practices: Provide the audience, time period, communication goal, and approved source material.
Confirm confidential details and permissions before using internal links or messages.
Review names, metrics, dates, links, and unresolved assumptions before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not invent achievements, metrics, answers, or source links.
Do not include sensitive material because it is available in a connected tool.
Do not use company-wide formats for narrow team details or duplicate announcements.

faq.question: Which communication formats are supported?
faq.answer: The skill supports 3P updates, company newsletters, employee FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, incident reports, and general messages.

faq.question: Does the skill require connected company tools?
faq.answer: No. You can provide notes directly, but connected sources may provide more complete context when access is authorized.

faq.question: How does the skill handle uncertain information?
faq.answer: It can label uncertainty, cite authoritative sources, and identify questions that require an official response.

faq.question: Can the skill use confidential information?
faq.answer: Only provide information approved for the intended audience. Review confidentiality, permissions, and links before publication.

faq.question: Does the skill publish or send messages?
faq.answer: No. It drafts communication content for review and does not send messages or modify source systems.

faq.question: What happens when a format is not covered?
faq.answer: The skill asks about audience, purpose, tone, and formatting before drafting a general internal communication.
